title: After Dune Delight Vacation Rental
meta_description: After Dune Delight is a 3.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionAfter Dune DelightSunset Beach CommunityHome Highlights3 Bedrooms (see “Room Details” for full layouts)4 BathroomsSleeps 6 Guests2,100 Sq. Ft.Gulf Views with abundant natural light and multiple indoor/outdoor living spacesThree covered balconies and three enclosed porches for morning coffee or sunset viewsPropane grill for outdoor diningGulf-front community pool (seasonally heated Nov 1 – Apr 30)Direct private beach access in a gated communitySeasonal use of four adult 26" bikes (additional rentals available)Walk or bike to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Seacrest VillageProperty OverviewAfter Dune Delight is a beautifully appointed three-story town home offering panoramic Gulf views, modern comforts, and plenty of space for relaxation. Situated in the private Sunset Beach community on the south side of 30A, it’s steps from the beach and a heated Gulf-front pool.First Floor: Private king guest suite with full bath.Second Floor: Open-plan living area and three porches for seamless indoor/outdoor living. The kitchen is outfitted with KitchenAid appliances, a wine cooler, and fully stocked cabinets.Third Floor: Spacious king master suite with two private balconies with Gulf Views and an en suite bath with walk-in shower. Queen guest bedroom also with private bath. With 10’ ceilings and large windows, every room is bright, airy, and inviting.Community AmenitiesHeated Gulf-front pool (Nov 1 – Apr 30)Direct private beach accessClose to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Village, and Inlet BeachParking- 4 total spaces: 2 in garage, 2 in drivewayReservation & Booking Policies50% deposit due at booking; remaining balance due 60 days before arrivalBookings within 60 days require full payment5% cancellation fee applies; initial deposit refundable if canceled >60 days before arrivalOptional travel insurance available if purchased before final paymentPrimary renter must be 25+ and present for entire stayCheck-In: 4:00 PM CST | Check-Out: 10:00 AM CSTNo smoking No pets (certified service animals allowed with notice and documentation)
